authority.authority_ref: Active Runbook Sentinel director goal in Codex task 019fd836-f77d-70f3-b529-fe691c8e6de2
authority.user_instruction: Continue selecting and shipping bounded evidence-driven checkpoints without routine approval while preserving the thesis, failed experiments, external-source gates, and security boundaries.

objective: Reject non-integer, nonpositive, and over-maximum approval lifetimes before mutation, prove exact recovery-preserving behavior across frozen development and held-out cases, and release only if every existing agent, policy, execution, package, and real-surface gate remains passing.

included: freeze an exact approval lifetime contract with development and held-out test cases
enforce integer TTL from 1 through 300 seconds in the deterministic approval broker
reject invalid API input with HTTP 400 before proposal, approval, audit, trace, or incident mutation
add an independent contract validator and separate evaluation metrics
version and verify CLI, API, MCP, dashboard, persistence, telemetry, package, clean clone, and public release
excluded: changing the agent, retriever, decision context, scenario catalog, action set, capability policy, executor, idempotency, replay, preconditions, postconditions, credentials, or real-infrastructure boundary
adding dependencies, services, secrets, external code, data, models, assets, containers, or package registries
describing the known negative-TTL development probe as held-out evidence
stop_conditions: dependency, external asset, spend, secret, access, ownership, real infrastructure, or irreversible action required
candidate or shipment cannot be verified

changed_risks: strict type and range validation can reject formerly coerced operator input
invalid input can still mutate proposal, approval, audit, trace, or incident state if validation occurs too late
valid minimum, maximum, and default approval lifetimes can regress
new evaluation logic can hide or rewrite the released negative-TTL failure
required_checks: approval lifetime contract freezes before candidate implementation
independent validator rejects split, type, bound, mutation, and expected-result corruption
released negative-TTL development control remains retained as fail
candidate passes all nine contract cases with held-out results revealed only after generic implementation
existing frozen 84-attempt evaluation and every real and packaged surface remain passing
clean clone, GitHub review, merged main, and public release reconcile
completed_checks: public v0.0.12 release closure and selected package bytes reconcile
fresh public-package orientation passes all 84 attempts and every existing gate
released real API accepts negative TTL and wedges the proposal in approved state
the exact bounded policy uses the existing 300-second default and imports no external source or asset

evidence: Public v0.0.12 is verified at release closure 9829f4e2309b9ebde83f7e1fc4f53f9e7e408b2a
Fresh public asset evaluation passes 28 scenarios and 84 attempts
Released dev-negative-ttl probe returns approval 201, expired execution 409, recovery approval 409, open incident, approved proposal, and unconsumed approval

units.purpose: Run public v0.0.12, inspect evaluation and traces, and measure one approval-lifetime weakness on the real released API
Freeze exact approval lifetime policy, split cases, invalid no-mutation terminal state, and unchanged boundaries before implementation
Implement strict deterministic TTL validation and an independent fail-closed contract validator
Reveal the frozen approval-lifetime suite once, add separate metrics, and compare all prior system gates
Version, package, clean-clone, review, merge, publish, and verify the bounded checkpoint

stop_conditions.condition: Weaken a security boundary or cross an explicit no-go boundary.
Spend money or add a paid service or secret.
Import externally controlled assets with unresolved rights or safety.
Ship something that cannot be verified.

handoff.active_weakness: candidate closes the released invalid approval-lifetime mutation gap; clean-clone, review, merge, and public-release truth remain
handoff.resume_rule: Resume from UNIT-005 and the selected c14a4559 package bytes; do not alter the candidate after the first package reveal or rerun broad ideation.
